Handle email, calendar, proposals and travel by voice call
A user described a 30-minute voice call where the bot answered about 20 emails, planned the calendar, wrote a proposal, ordered lunch, booked a hotel and arranged a cab.
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
The source only gives a one-sentence mention of this, relayed from a user on X. The user phoned their Grok Bot and talked for 30 minutes. In that call it answered about 20 emails, planned the week's calendar, wrote a proposal, ordered lunch, booked and paid for a hotel, and arranged a cab to the airport. The source gives no setup details.
How it went
The source reports the call as a success and gives no failures, costs or accuracy checks. It doesn't say whether the user reviewed the emails or payments.
Worth knowing
By default the Bot stops for approval before sending, buying or deleting, and passwords and 2FA codes always come back to you. Keep those approvals on for anything involving payments.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
I'm going to give you a list of tasks to handle for the day: go through my inbox and draft replies to [number] emails, plan my calendar for [date], write a proposal for [client and project], and arrange [lunch, hotel in city, or ride]. Work through them in order, and before you send any email, place any order, book anything, or spend money, pause and show me exactly what you're about to do. At the end, give me a short list of what's done and what still needs my decision.
Original source: https://www.paralect.com/stack/grok-bot
